raw.description: List connected WooCommerce stores in this Whathead workspace. Use this first to discover store labels before pulling products, orders, or sales reports. Requires scope: read:accounts.

include_disconnected.description: Include stores that were disconnected. Default: false.

raw.description: WooCommerce read-only commerce operations: products, orders, customers, coupons, sales reports, top sellers, Analytics reports/stats, report totals, and custom sales breakdowns by date, product, category, coupon, customer, country, status, or payment method. Requires scope: read:reports.

action.description: Read operation. Includes REST products/orders/customers/coupons, report totals, WooCommerce Analytics reports, and custom sales breakdowns.

label.description: WooCommerce connection label shown in Whathead integrations. Use woocommerce_list_stores first to discover labels.

payload.description: Action-specific body. Common pagination: { page?, perPage? }. LIST_PRODUCTS supports search/status/type/sku/category/tag/minPrice/maxPrice/onSale/inStock. LIST_ORDERS supports status/customer/product/after/before. GET_PRODUCT requires { productId }. GET_ORDER requires { orderId }. GET_SALES_REPORT / GET_TOP_SELLERS support { period? | dateMin/dateMax | startDate/endDate }. GET_REVENUE_STATS and *_STATS actions support { after|startDate, before|endDate, interval? }. GET_REPORT_TOTALS requires { report: "orders/totals" | "products/totals" | "customers/totals" | "coupons/totals" | "reviews/totals" | "categories/totals" | "tags/totals" | "attributes/totals" }. GET_ANALYTICS_REPORT requires { endpoint, expectList? } for any supported wc-analytics report endpoint. GET_SALES_BREAKDOWN supports { groupBy: date|product|sku|variation|category|coupon|status|country|customer|payment_method, interval: day|week|month|quarter|year, startDate/endDate, status?, maxPages?, perPage?, limit?, sortBy?, sortDir? }.
